and regional media. To create the “corrupted“ verification statements, we uniformly perturb final

Mega Millions Lottery. We use the official winning lottery numbers as published and maintained by
the State of New York going back to 2002 [142]. The Mega Millions winning lottery numbers are
unlikely to generate sustained coverage, given that their relevance is highly ephemeral. We request
models to generate/verify both the winning numbers and the “mega ball.” Noisy versions are created
by sampling 2 out of the 5 winning numbers and perturbing uniformly by values in ± [1, 20]. We
sample 40 data points per year.

facts.description: 可设时temperature=.2；事实处于所列模型知识截止时间以内；现成Gemini3.1FlashLite作输出解析和评分。

evidence.quote: facts that fall inside the knowledge cutoffs
evidence.excerpt:
H.1    Models

We use commercially available models from two of the most popular providers: Google and OpenAI.
To measure the effects of compression and computational constraints, we evaluate models at different
distillation sizes and ablate the effect of different “thinking” or “reasoning” levels. Where possible,
we set the temperature to 0.2 to enhance reproducibility. We ensure natural experiment queries use
facts that fall inside the knowledge cutoffs. Full details are available in Table 4.
Throughout all natural experiments, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite was used to parse and evaluate outputs
against ground truth answers.

Table 4: Flagship model comparison. The current generation models released in 2026 all support
a “thinking” parameter, modulating how many tokens models generate before providing their final
response. While all models likely undergo some form of quantization to speed up inference, the
“Flash Lite” model family line is the only one reported to quantize to INT4. Publicly shared reports
do not mention quantization details for the smaller Gemini 3 Flash and GPT 5.4 Mini.
